kai (oncall): Postmortem quick follow-up — recurring autoscaler backfills + KV cold starts. Last incident: p99 ~1.8s for 35m, throughput -30%. We keep patching SLOs; propose a different approach (burst credits + guarded error-budget shifts). Thoughts?

leah (infra): Agree. Short-term: tag replacement events and add a startup_grace so joins don't count against SLO. I'll own tagging + dashboard panels. ETA 18h.

omar (serving): Serving plan: KV pre-warm flow, soft per-customer batch caps during ramps, and a fallback routing pool. Will add metrics: burst_credit_balance, kv_warm_pct. ETA 48h.

dina (product): Product prefers opt-in burst credits for enterprise first and clear comms. I'll draft comms + SLA matrix. ETA 24h.

notify-bot: Incident INC-2026-211 logged: autoscaler backfill correlated with KV misses.

kai (oncall): Draft SLO sketch to discuss:
"""
service: inference-api
steady_p99_ms: 500
ramp_tier:
  burst_credit_per_10m: 3000
  p95_rps: 150
error_budget_shift:
  enabled: true
  max_shift_pct: 0.02
"""
This isolates expected ramp noise into bounded credits so steady-state latency budget isn't repeatedly burned.

leah (infra): Will add ramp_index metric (node_join_rate + traffic_accel) and export ramp_events with tags (autoscaler_backfill, region_failover).

omar (serving): Alerts I'll add: "burst_credit_low (5m)" and "kv_warm_pct < 80% (10m)". Also will stage canary for pre-warm.

dina (product): Action items:
- leah (infra): tagging + ramp_index panels (due 18h)
- omar (serving): pre-warm + batch cap + alerts (due 48h)
- dina (product): SLA review + comms draft (due 24h)
- kai (oncall): open SLO config PR + decision invite (due 6h)

kai (oncall): Opening PR placeholder: https://git.redwood/slo-config/pulls/871. Scheduling decision sync in 4 days to decide opt-in trial vs global change: https://cal.link/4day-burst-decision. Closing thread for updates — please post PR/canary links here. :white_check_mark:
